content.short: USDD is a decentralized, crypto-collateralised stablecoin pegged to the US dollar.
content.description: USDD (Decentralized USD) is a stablecoin pegged to the US dollar and backed by crypto reserves, with a savings product that pays yield. It reports more than $1.5 billion in supply. Stable's official ecosystem page lists USDD.
content.meta: USDD is a crypto-collateralised decentralized US dollar stablecoin, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
